decks.notes: The deck focuses on aggressive plays, utilizing efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Territorial Kavu to put pressure on the opponent. The deck also has access to powerful removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Tribal Flames to control the board. Leyline of the Guildpact and Leyline Binding help to support the aggro strategy by boosting the power of multicolored creatures like Scion of Draco. Consign to Memory provides additional card advantage and flexibility, allowing the deck to stay ahead in the game. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly and efficiently.

The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly and efficiently with cards like Amulet of Vigor, Arboreal Grazer, and Primeval Titan, while utilizing lands like Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and Vesuva to deal massive amounts of damage to the opponent. It also includes utility lands like Gruul Turf and The Mycosynth Gardens to support the combo. The goal is to assemble the necessary pieces to either generate a huge amount of mana or to tutor for specific win conditions like Scapeshift or Dryad of the Ilysian Grove to overwhelm the opponent in a single turn.

This deck focuses on utilizing creatures with various abilities to disrupt and control the opponent while maintaining a aggressive tempo. It takes advantage of cards like Ephemerate and Flickerwisp to protect or reuse powerful creatures like Emperor of Bones and Ketramose, the New Dawn. Thoughtseize and Fatal Push help control the opponent's resources, while Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd and Witch Enchanter generate value over time. The deck also includes some anti-graveyard hate with Relic of Progenitus. Overall, it aims to put pressure on the opponent while disrupting their game plan.

This combo deck focuses on using artifacts and counterspells to control the game while building up mana for a powerful finisher in Goblin Charbelcher. The deck includes a variety of ways to disrupt your opponent's strategy and protect your own game plan, while also including card draw and tutoring effects to help assemble the combo pieces. By carefully managing your resources and timing your plays, you can set up a game-winning Charbelcher activation that can deal massive damage to your opponent in a single turn.

This deck focuses on playing aggressive creatures and dealing direct damage to the opponent with cards like Lightning Bolt and Tribal Flames. It also utilizes Leyline cards to control the board and protect key creatures. The mana base is designed to support a wide range of colors in order to cast powerful spells such as Scion of Draco and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury. The goal is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with creatures and burn spells before they can establish their own board presence.

This deck focuses on generating mana quickly with Eldrazi Temple and Urza's Saga to ramp into powerful Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul, the Promised End. It also uses cards like Writhing Chrysalis and Basking Broodscale to create tokens and sacrifice them for value with Kozilek's Command and Blade of the Bloodchief. Glaring Fleshraker serves as a disruptive element to control the board while Malevolent Rumble clears the way for lethal attacks. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of powerful creatures, removal, and token generation.

The deck focuses on utilizing Eldrazi creatures and ramping up mana quickly to cast powerful spells and abilities, while also controlling the board with removal and disruption. It aims to overwhelm the opponent with massive threats like Emrakul, the Promised End and World Breaker, supported by cards like Kozilek's Return and Malevolent Rumble to deal with opposing threats. The deck also includes ways to generate additional mana and card advantage through cards like Ugin's Labyrinth and Sanctum of Ugin. Overall, the strategy revolves around harnessing the immense power of Eldrazi creatures while maintaining control of the game.

The main idea of this Jeskai Control deck is to control the game by disrupting the opponent's plans and removing their threats with cards like Prismatic Ending, Force of Negation, and Wrath of the Skies. The deck also focuses on card advantage and selection through cards like Stock Up, Tune the Narrative, and Consign to Memory. Additionally, the deck includes powerful finishers like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Nulldrifter. The mana base is carefully constructed to ensure the deck can consistently cast its spells and control the game until it can secure a win.

The main concept of the deck is to quickly disrupt the opponent's hand and board state through a combination of discard spells like Inquisition of Kozilek and Thoughtseize, removal spells like Fatal Push, and powerful creatures like Thought-Knot Seer and Nethergoyf. With a mix of disruption, card advantage from Mishra's Bauble, and efficient threats, the deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain control throughout the game, utilizing cards like Kozilek's Command and Emperor of Bones to close out the game. The deck also utilizes Urza's Saga to create powerful artifacts and generate additional value.

This deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and powerful multicolor spells. By maximizing the use of Leylines and Leyline Binding, as well as utilizing cards like Tribal Flames and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, the deck can quickly deal damage and control the battlefield. The diverse mana base allows for flexibility in casting spells, while cards like Stubborn Denial and Spectral Denial provide protection and disruption against the opponent's strategies. Overall, this deck's strength lies in its ability to apply pressure early and maintain control throughout the game.

The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly with cards like Astral Cornucopia and Everflowing Chalice, while utilizing cards like Mystic Forge and Ugin, the Eye of the Storm to control the board and generate card advantage. Karn, the Great Creator can shut down opponents' artifacts, while Mishra's Bauble and Surge Node provide additional value. Glaring Fleshraker and Devourer of Destiny offer threats on the board, supported by Eldrazi Temple and Ugin's Labyrinth for additional mana and control. The deck aims to establish board dominance and overwhelm opponents with powerful plays.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with a combination of efficient creatures and burn spells. The key strategy is to apply pressure early with cheap threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Guide of Souls, while using removal spells like Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment to clear the way. Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury provides a powerful finisher, while Ajani, Nacatl Pariah can help pump up the team for a final push. The deck also includes disruptive cards like Static Prison and Thraben Charm to disrupt the opponent's game plan.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly deploying a board presence and attacking aggressively with powerful creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury. The deck also includes removal spells like Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment to control the board and maintain pressure on the opponent. With cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker providing additional support and synergy, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast-paced and devastating offense.

The deck focuses on generating mana quickly through rituals and Medallions, to cast spells like Grapeshot or Ral's abilities multiple times in a turn. Past in Flames allows for spell recursion, while Wish can fetch key combo pieces. Dragon's Rage Channeler provides card filtering, while Glimpse the Impossible helps to dig for combo pieces. The deck runs a low land count to maximize spell density, with Sunbaked Canyon for card draw. Overall, the deck aims to create a storm of spells to overwhelm the opponent quickly and efficiently.

The deck utilizes aggressive creatures like Detective's Phoenix, Hollow One, and Nethergoyf to quickly pressure the opponent. It also includes cards like Burning Inquiry, Faithless Looting, and Goblin Lore to efficiently fill the graveyard and cast creatures for cheap. The deck runs a low land count to maximize spells and creatures on the board, with key removal like Fatal Push and Lightning Bolt to maintain board control. The inclusion of cards like Nihil Spellbomb and Arena of Glory provide disruption and protection against graveyard strategies. Ultimately, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and disruptive game plan.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on utilizing powerful aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury to quickly chip away at the opponent's life total. It also includes cards like Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment to deal direct damage and control the board. The deck also has a strong mana base with fetch lands like Arid Mesa and Sacred Foundry, as well as disruptive cards like Blood Moon to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with fast and efficient aggression.
